subject: [PATCH 17/60] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the hibernation image sizing, specifically ensuring that pages used to store the image come from common memory. The changes modify functions such as `count_free_highmem_pages` and `hibernate_preallocate_memory` to only count free pages on nodes with N_MEMORY_COMMON state.
